title: Informal Expert Group on the carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM)

leadDgs.label: TAXUD - DG Taxation and Customs Union

mission: The overall mission of the group shall be to assist DG TAXUD in the development and implementation of the CBAM, in particular for the adoption of the non-legislative acts which may be required, and to bring about an exchange of experience and good practices.

tasks.label: Assist the Commission in relation to the implementation of existing Union legislation, programmes and policies
Assist the Commission in the preparation of delegated acts
Assist the Commission in the preparation of legislative proposals and policy initiatives
Coordinate with Member States, exchange of views
Provides expertise to the Commission when preparing implementing measures, i.e. before the Commission submits these draft measures to a comitology committee
